jobs.title: What If You Fell Into a Black Hole?
jobs.description:
Fall into a black hole and gravity pulls your feet much harder than your head, stretching you like spaghetti. Your friend far away sees your clock slow down and you freeze at the edge. But a giant black hole has a twist.

#blackhole #space #whatif #science #shorts
